page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6a.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an AMD EPYC 7H12 processor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture at a base clock speed of 2.6 GHz, the system provides 64 dedicated vCPUs alongside 512.0 GB of system memory. This yields a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core, targeting enterprise applications requiring high memory density.

The instance does not include integrated local storage or hardware GPU accelerators, delegating data persistence entirely to network-attached block storage services. Networking capabilities feature a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses assigned by default.

From an infrastructure perspective, the dedicated allocation of 64 physical-grade virtual cores combined with half a terabyte of RAM allows efficient execution of memory-heavy architectures. Primary workload fits include large in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, large-scale enterprise resource planning systems, and batch in-memory analytics pipelines.
